title: Header controls named by their visible text
assertion: Each header control's accessible name contains its visible text (WCAG 2.5.3) at 1280 and 390 px; axe 4.14 with the WCAG 2.0/2.1 A and AA tags finds no violation on any page a journey scans
noFileReason: The brand journey reads the header's accessible names and visible text in the browser, and every journey's axe scan reads its pages; no file.
